articles.summary: The Company Also Announces a New Share Repurchase Plan WESTFIELD, Mass., April 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Western New England Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company” or “WNEB”) (NasdaqGS: WNEB), the holding company for Westfield Bank (the “Bank”), announced today the unaudited results of operations for the three months ended March 31, 2025.
